personality_one_liner: A warm, trustworthy, and highly readable iOS-native experience that removes the stress from sharing roommate finances.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Accommodate longer Turkish words (e.g. 'Denkleştir', 'Harcamalar') without cramping or truncation. Cards always get md/lg padding.

do's: Use frosted glass overlays on bottom tab bars
Use glass on sticky headers over scrolling feeds like Harcamalar
Use glass on the 'Settle Up / Denkleştir' sticky bottom CTA container
dont's: Never blur item list rows or form inputs

screens.name: Panel (Dashboard)
screens.purpose: Overview of the household pool, showing who paid what, with a filterable running total.

states.loading: Skeleton UI for top balance cards and recent list
states.empty: Illustration of a happy apartment with text 'Henüz bir harcama yok. İlk fişi tara!' (No expenses yet. Scan the first receipt!)
states.error: Error loading household data with a 'Tekrar Dene' (Retry) CTA

screens.layout: Top section uses a hero card with a warm sand texture and glass overlay showing 'Ev Bakiyesi' (Household Balance). Below it: quick breakdown per roommate (Avatar + Net Balance). Bottom half: Filterable sticky tabs for 'Tümü' (All), 'Bu Ay' (This Month) over a scrolling list of recent expenses.

screens.name: Fiş Tara (Receipt Scan Capture)
screens.purpose: Camera capture interface dedicated to framing and snapping a German grocery receipt.

states.empty: Camera viewfinder with a rectangular framing guide and edge detection hints

screens.layout: Full-screen camera. Minimal UI. Prominent capture button at the bottom. A small 'Galeriden Seç' (Choose from Gallery) icon next to it. After capture, show a 'Fatura okunuyor...' (Reading receipt...) processing overlay.

screens.name: Fiş İnceleme (OCR Review & Correction)
screens.purpose: Editable line-item list to fix OCR mistakes and assign items to specific roommates or household.

states.loading: Waiting for Gemini Vision API to finish parsing
states.empty: No items found (fallback to manual entry)
states.error: OCR failed, show 'Fiş okunamadı, lütfen manuel girin' (Receipt could not be read, please enter manually)

screens.layout: Three-part stack: 1. Top sticky header with receipt thumbnail and total. 2. Scrollable list of items. Each row has inline editing (Name, Price right-aligned) and a 3-way segment chip below it: 'Kendim' (Self), 'Ev' (Household), 'Oda Arkadaşı' (Roommate). 3. Fixed bottom glass container with recalculating 'Toplam' and primary 'Kaydet' (Save) CTA.

screens.name: Harcamalar (Expenses & History)
screens.purpose: Chronological archive of all household and personal expenses, separated by settled periods.
screens.layout: List-heavy view with a glass sticky header. Filterable by person and date. Visual separation between current active period and archived 'Kapatılmış Dönemler' (Closed Periods).

screens.name: Denge (Settle Up)
screens.purpose: Simplified debt visualization showing who owes whom, and the final action to close the period.

states.empty: Text: 'Herkes ödeşmiş durumda! 🎉' (Everyone is settled up!)

screens.layout: Clean cards stating 'A kişisi B kişisine X € borçlu' (Person A owes Person B X €). Prominent 'Dönemi Kapat & Denkleştir' (Close Period & Settle) primary CTA pinned at the bottom in a safe-area cleared glass container.

screens.name: Manuel Ekle (Manual Entry)
screens.purpose: A quick form to add an expense without a receipt (e.g., utilities, rent).
screens.layout: Single column form. Floating labels above inputs. Large amount input at the top. Same 3-way assignment chip picker (Kendim, Ev, Oda Arkadaşı) and free-text category tags. Sticky 'Ekle' (Add) button over keyboard.

hero_background.alt: Abstract warm sand texture representing a calm, neutral household

receipt_placeholder.alt: Close-up of a receipt showing details

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Do NOT introduce blue, indigo, or purple. Terracotta (brand) and Sage Green (success) are the primary accents on top of warm off-white.

Typography MUST use 'Plus Jakarta Sans'. Accommodate long Turkish copy (e.g., 'Denkleştir', 'Oda Arkadaşı') by letting text wrap or using flexible flex layouts. Avoid fixed widths for text containers.
Implement the 'Fiş İnceleme' (OCR Review) screen with editable line items. Users must be able to change price/name and assign targets via chips right in the row.
Ensure the 'Denge' (Settle) screen uses a debt simplification algorithm visualization. Clean cards should declare 'A owes B' clearly.
Implement sticky primary CTAs over scrolling content using the exact glassmorphism setup defined in the design system.
The camera capture UI should be minimal. Only show framing guides and a shutter button. Transition to a loading state overlay while Gemini OCR is processing.
Always use the provided background image with a vertical gradient-to-dark scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) before placing any white text on it.
